answer: Re-attestations are stored in delta and canyon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 982 impostors cost 114 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
